purpose: Difficulty-covering blinded-validation slice for the Day 8 gate. Frozen before any environment build, oracle check, or agent run for these tasks.

sampling.method: stratified seeded shuffle per official difficulty band; the slice takes the first selected_count ids of each seeded_candidate_order
sampling.frame: repo == django/django AND version >= 4.0 AND instance_id != django__django-15851; strata are the official SWE-bench Verified difficulty labels
frame_constraints_reasons: django/django is the family with a recorded passing ARM64 source-build oracle check (Day 7); staying inside it keeps the environment risk bounded and is stated openly as a scope limit.
version >= 4.0 pins conda environments to Python >= 3.8, which are reliable on aarch64; Django 3.x maps to Python 3.6, which is not dependable in aarch64 conda.
django__django-15851 is excluded because it was already run on Day 7 and its reveal review is recorded as non-blinded.

The >4 hours band is absent from django/django (3 instances exist benchmark-wide, none in the frame); the slice therefore covers the three available official bands and says so rather than borrowing an out-of-frame task.

substitution_rule: If a selected instance fails its environment build or its gold-patch oracle check on this host, record the failure in data/environment-checks/ and replace it with the next id in the same stratum seeded_candidate_order. Agent-phase failures are NOT substitution grounds: a harness exception is recorded and rerun at most once (both trials kept); if both fail, the instance stays in the slice as an unimportable trial and is reported as excluded with its reason.

run_configuration.agent_model: the Hy3 endpoint model configured in the ignored .env, passed as openai/<HY3_MODEL> with OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL via --env-file
run_configuration.judge: the fixed Hy3 judge configuration recorded in each evaluation (semantic-prompt-v1, process-rubric-v1)
run_configuration.environment: locally built ARM64 instance images from the official swebench==4.0.3 harness; task copies prepared by scripts/prepare_swebench_task.py from harbor-datasets commit 86723674f04e4209ac479d0fb75d9d9f44b4377e

blinding_protocol: After import, evaluation runs with the response verdict suppressed: the operator terminal displays only completion status, never process_status, findings, or first_error.
All initial labels are entered through the blinded UI, one run after another, before any revealed verdict is inspected.
Reveals and adjudications happen only after every initial label in the slice is saved.
Reviewer alias operator-blinded-day8; each review notes the protocol. The Day 7 review (operator-day7) remains non-blinded and excluded from validation metrics via slice scoping.
